items.title: Gina Rinehart puts ABC on notice over Race Around the World episode
items.description: Hancock Prospecting has formally placed ABC Chair Kim Williams AM, Deputy Chair Lisa Caffery and Managing Director Hugh Marks on notice and foreshadowed possible legal action.

items.title: NDIS provider pockets $1 million after incorrectly billing participants
items.description: Some NDIS service providers have been referred to the ACCC as the government reveals thousands have been engaging in questionable billing practices, including using funds to pay for float tanks and golf lessons.

items.title: Hundreds gather to farewell allegedly murdered teen Layla Jeffery
items.description: Hundreds of mourners gather in Victoria's west to say farewell to 13-year-old Layla Jeffrey after her remains were found earlier this month.

items.title: Medical team survives 36 hours adrift before remarkable rescue
items.description: Six Fiji health workers survive a harrowing ordeal at sea thanks to a former classmate of one of the survivors.

items.title: ABC withdraws third story by sacked reporter Mahmood Fazal
items.description: The ABC has withdrawn a third story by sacked reporter Mahmood Fazal due to concerns about accuracy.

items.title: Judge reserves decision in unmasking high-profile man in alleged extortion case
items.description: MM's name has been suppressed by a Cairns court since late May, although he was not the direct target of the alleged threat.

items.title: Live: 'Got that wrong': Dragons make bright start after Bunker denies Dolphins
items.description: St George Illawarra hosts the Dolphins to begin Friday's NRL action. Follow live.

items.title: Why farmers are spreading crushed glass on their crops
items.description: Recycled glass is being turned into a silicon-rich soil additive that farmers say is improving crop growth while creating a new use for millions of discarded bottles.

items.title: No CCTV, no eyewitnesses in Luke Gosling assault case, lawyer claims
items.description: Federal Labor MP Luke Gosling has been banned from approaching Government House in Darwin after facing court for the first time since being charged with assaulting the Northern Territory administrator, the territory's equivalent of a state governor.

items.title: Trump's Hamas plan a 'huge moment' that raises a lot of questions
items.description: Middle East analysts are sceptical Hamas will willingly lay down its weapons and that Israel will totally withdraw from Gaza.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
